quests.name: Desert Survival Kits
quests.text: Bring 4 Globes of Water, 4 Powerful Anti-Venom and 4 Baked Salmon to Calandrath at the inn in Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

quests.name: The Spirits of Southwind
quests.text: Free the spirits of 8 Tortured Druids and 8 Tortured Sentinels in Southwind Village, and then return to Layo Starstrike at the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus.

quests.name: Deadly Desert Venom
quests.text: Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to gather 8 Stonelash Scorpid Stingers and 8 Sand Skitterer Fangs. Return to her when you have completed the task.

quests.name: Securing the Supply Lines
quests.text: Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to kill 15 Dredge Strikers.

quests.name: Hive in the Tower
quests.text: Scale the tower of Southwind Village and locate a means to stir the silithid hive into activity. Bring back anything unusual you may uncover when doing so to Layo Starstrike at the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus.

quests.name: Umber, Archivist
quests.text: Take the Encrusted Silithid Object to Umber - the Cenarion Circle's archivist - in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

quests.name: Noggle's Last Hope
quests.text: Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to gather 3 Stonelash Pincer Stingers, 3 Stonelash Flayer Stingers and 3 Rock Stalker Fangs.

quests.name: Stepping Up Security
quests.text: Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to slay 20 Dredge Crushers.

quests.name: Desert Recipe
quests.text: Look for information about cooking Sandworm Meat at the Twilight's Hammer camp west of Cenarion Hold.

quests.name: Sharing the Knowledge
quests.text: Bring the Torn Recipe Page to Calandrath at the inn in Cenarion Hold.

quests.name: Kitchen Assistance
quests.text: Calandrath at Cenarion Hold needs a batch of 10 Smoked Desert Dumplings.

quests.name: Noggle's Lost Satchel
quests.text: Retrieve Noggle's Satchel from the mountains in the south of Silithus and return it to him at Cenarion Hold.

quests.name: The Twilight Mystery
quests.text: Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to collect 8 Twilight Tablet Fragments.

quests.name: Wanted - Deathclasp, Terror of the Sands
quests.text: Bring Deathclasp's Pincer to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard.

quests.name: The Deserter
quests.text: Take the restored tablet to Hermit Ortell in Silithus.

quests.name: True Believers
quests.text: Hermit Ortell wants you to bring him 10 Encrypted Twilight Texts

quests.name: Primestone the Elder
notes: You can only get this quest while the Lunar Festival world event is running.

quests.name: Bladesing the Elder
notes: You can only get this quest while the Lunar Festival world event is running.

quests.name: Report to Marshal Bluewall
quests.text: Speak with Marshal Bluewall at the Alliance encampment near Hive'Zora.

quests.name: Report to General Kirika
quests.text: Speak with General Kirika at the Horde encampment near Hive'Regal.

quests.name: Scouring the Desert
quests.text: Find and deliver Silithyst to the Silithyst Extractor, then speak with Marshal Bluewall at the Alliance encampment near Hive'Zora.

quests.name: Scouring the Desert
quests.text: Find and deliver Silithyst to the Silithyst Extractor then speak with General Kirika at the Horde encampment near Hive'Regal.

quests.name: Secrets of the Colossus - Ashi
quests.text: Take the Colossus of Ashi's Husk to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
notes: The husk vanishes 2 hours after you get it, so go straight to Booty Bay.

quests.name: Secrets of the Colossus - Regal
quests.text: Take the Colossus of Regal's Husk to Overseer Oilfist in Searing Gorge.
notes: The husk disappears after 2 hours, so go straight to Searing Gorge.

quests.name: Secrets of the Colossus - Zora
quests.text: Take the Colossus of Zora's Husk to Lord Maxwell Tyrosus at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
notes: The husk disappears after 2 hours, so travel straight to Light's Hope.

quests.name: The Twilight Lexicon
quests.text: Bring the three chapters of the Twilight Lexicon to Hermit Ortell in Silithus.

quests.name: A Terrible Purpose
quests.text: Take the Decoded Tablet Parchment to Commander Mar'alith.

quests.name: Desert Survival Kits
quests.text: Bring 4 Globes of Water, 4 Powerful Anti-Venom and 4 Smoked Desert Dumplings to Calandrath at the inn in Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing I in order to complete this quest.

quests.name: Secret Communication
quests.text: Bring 10 Encrypted Twilight Texts to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.

quests.name: Dearest Natalia
quests.text: Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to question the inhabitants of Bronzebeard's Encampment. You will find Bronzebeard's Encampment south of Cenarion Hold.  Once you have gathered the requested information, return to Commander Mar'alith.

quests.name: Into The Maw of Madness
quests.text: Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to find his beloved Natalia. The information that you gathered points to Hive'Regal in the south as being the area in which you may find Mistress Natalia Mar'alith.  Do not forget to visit the dwarves at Bronzebeard's camp before venturing into the hive. They might have some additional work and advice for you.  And <Name>, remember the Commander's words: "Do what you must..."

objectives.text: The Fate of Mistress Natalia Mar'alith

quests.name: Brann Bronzebeard's Lost Letter
quests.text: Take Brann Bronzebeard's Letter to Bronzebeard's Encampment in southern Silithus.

quests.name: Glyph Chasing
quests.text: Rutgar Glyphshaper at Bronzebeard's Encampment in Silithus wants you to venture to Hive'Ashi, Hive'Zora, and Hive'Regal and recover Glyphed Rubbings from the Glyphed Crystals of each hive.  Use the Geologist's Transcription Kit to make a reasonable facsimile of the ancient glyphs. Return to Rutgar Glyphshaper when you complete this task.

quests.name: Breaking the Code
quests.text: Frankal Stonebridge at Bronzebeard's Encampment in Silithus wants you to recover a Hive'Zora Silithid Brain, Hive'Ashi Silithid Brain, and a Hive'Regal Silithid Brain. Return to Frankal when you have completed this task.

quests.name: Unraveling the Mystery
quests.text: Rutgar Glyphshaper at Bronzebeard's Encampment wants you to deliver the Glyphed Crystal Prism to Geologist Larksbane at the Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

quests.name: The Calling
quests.text: Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to recover the Crystal Unlocking Mechanism from the Qiraji Emissary.  You have been instructed to take the Glyphs of Calling to the Bones of Grakkarond, south of Cenarion Hold, and draw them in the sand. Should the Qiraji Emissary appear, slay it and recover the Crystal Unlocking Mechanism. Return to Geologist Larksbane if you succeed.  Assemble an army for this task, <Name>!

quests.name: Armaments of War
notes: This is a raid quest, so plan for a raid group of about 30 or more players.

quests.name: Armaments of War
notes: This is a raid quest, so you need a raid group to finish it.

quests.name: A Humble Offering
quests.text: Aurel Goldleaf at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to bring her 1 Abyssal Scepter. You must also be Honored with the Cenarion Circle.

quests.name: Examine the Vessel
quests.text: Examine the Vessel of Rebirth and return it to Highlord Demitrian.

quests.name: Thunderaan the Windseeker
quests.text: To free Thunderaan the Windseeker from his prison, you must present the right and left halves of the Bindings of the Windseeker, 10 bars of Elementium, and the Essence of the Firelord to Highlord Demitrian in Silithus.
notes: Both binding halves and the Essence come from Molten Core raid bosses, so a 40-player raid is needed.

quests.name: Rise, Thunderfury!
quests.text: Present the Dormant Wind Kissed Blade to Highlord Demitrian.
notes: The blade comes from Prince Thunderaan, a raid boss with no fixed spawn. Demitrian summons him, so you need a raid group.

quests.name: What Tomorrow Brings
quests.text: Venture to the Caverns of Time in Tanaris and find Anachronos, Brood of Nozdormu.

quests.name: The Path of the Righteous
quests.text: Collect 200 Silithid Carapace Fragments and return to Baristolth.

quests.name: The Hand of the Righteous
quests.text: Collect 200 Silithid Carapace Fragments and return to Baristolth.
notes: Hive mobs are elite, so a group is recommended.

quests.name: Anachronos
quests.text: Seek out Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

quests.name: Long Forgotten Memories
quests.text: Locate the Crystalline Tear in Silithus and gaze into its depths.

quests.name: Twilight Geolords
quests.text: Kill 10 Twilight Geolords, then return to Huum Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.

quests.name: Vyral the Vile
quests.text: Bring Vyral's Signet Ring to Huum Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.

quests.name: Aurel Goldleaf
quests.text: Speak with Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.

quests.name: Dukes of the Council
quests.text: Bring 1 Large Brilliant Shard and 3 Abyssal Crests to Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.
notes: Templars are elite, so bring a group.

quests.name: Medallion of Station
notes: The Crimson Templar is elite, so a group may be needed.

quests.name: Lords of the Council
quests.text: Bring 5 Large Brilliant Shards and 3 Abyssal Signets to Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.

quests.name: Twilight Ring of Lordship
notes: The Dukes are elite and spawn only when summoned. They have no static spawn.

quests.name: Goldleaf's Discovery
quests.text: Speak with Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.

quests.name: Signet of the Dukes
quests.text: Bring the Abyssal Signet to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.

quests.name: Bor Wildmane
quests.text: Speak with Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.

quests.name: Bor Wishes to Speak
quests.text: Speak with Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.

quests.name: Scepter of the Council
quests.text: Bring an Abyssal Scepter to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.

quests.name: Abyssal Contacts
quests.text: Bor Wildmane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to destroy an Abyssal Templar and bring him an Abyssal Crest as proof of the deed.

quests.name: Abyssal Crests
notes: Templars do not spawn on their own; you have to summon them, and they are elite, so bring a group.

quests.name: Abyssal Signets
notes: Dukes are elite; bring a group.

quests.name: Abyssal Scepters
notes: The lords are raid bosses and only appear when summoned at a Greater Windstone.

quests.name: Bandages for the Field
quests.text: Bring 30 Heavy Runecloth Bandages, 30 Heavy Silk Bandages and 30 Heavy Mageweave Bandages to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing X in order to complete this quest.

quests.name: Desert Survival Kits
quests.text: Bring 4 Globes of Water, 4 Powerful Anti-Venom and 4 Smoked Desert Dumplings to Calandrath at the inn in Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing I in order to complete this quest.

quests.name: Twilight Battle Orders
quests.text: Obtain the Twilight Battle Orders and bring them Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing X in order to complete this quest.

quests.name: Target: Hive'Ashi Stingers
quests.text: Kill 30 Hive'Ashi Stingers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing XII in order to complete this quest.
notes: Stingers are elite, so bring a group.
The starting briefing item comes out of container item 22648 and must be kept until turn-in.

quests.name: Target: Hive'Ashi Workers
quests.text: Slay 30 Hive'Ashi Workers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing III in order to complete this quest.
notes: The workers are elite, so this is a group quest.

quests.name: Field Duty
quests.text: Report for duty at the Ironforge Brigade post near Hive'Zora. Prepare your Unsigned Field Duty Papers and obtain Signed Field Duty Papers from Captain Blackanvil and return to Windcaller Kaldon at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.  Note: Healing or casting beneficial spells on a member of the Ironforge Brigade will flag you for PvP.

quests.name: A Pawn on the Eternal Board
quests.text: Learn all that you can of the past, then speak with Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

objectives.text: The War of the Shifting Sands

quests.name: Hive'Zora Scout Report
quests.text: Contact Cenarion Scout Azenel inside Hive'Zora and return the Hive'Zora Scout Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing VI in order to complete this quest.

quests.name: Hoary Templar
quests.text: Summon and slay a Hoary Templar and report back to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing IV in order to complete this quest.
notes: The templar has no static spawn. It only shows up after you summon it at a wind stone.
Tactical Task Briefing IV comes from a container item, 21133, and you must still have it at turn-in.
The templar is elite, so you need a group.

quests.name: Earthen Templar
quests.text: Summon and slay an Earthen Templar and report back to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing III in order to complete this quest.

quests.name: Crimson Templar
quests.text: Summon and slay a Crimson Templar and report back to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing II in order to complete this quest.
notes: The Crimson Templar has no fixed spawn. It only appears when summoned at a wind stone while wearing the Twilight cultist gear.
The templar is elite, so bring a group.

quests.name: The Four Dukes
quests.text: Find a way to summon and slay the Duke of Cynders, the Duke of Fathoms, the Duke of Zephyrs and the Duke of Shards and report back to Commander Mar'alith in Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing V in order to complete this quest.
notes: The dukes have no fixed spawn. Each one has to be summoned at a wind stone.

quests.name: Target: Hive'Zora Hive Sisters
quests.text: Slay 30 Hive'Zora Hive Sisters and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing V in order to complete this quest.

quests.name: Boots for the Guard
quests.text: Bring 3 Ornate Mithril Boots to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing II in order to complete this quest.

quests.name: Grinding Stones for the Guard
quests.text: Bring 10 Dense Grinding Stones, 10 Solid Grinding Stones and 10 Heavy Grinding Stones to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing III in order to complete this quest.
notes: The briefing item comes out of a container, item 20805. You must still have it in your bags when you turn the quest in.

quests.name: Volunteer's Battlegear
quests.text: Bring 5 Cenarion Combat Badges, 3 Cenarion Logistics Badges and 7 Cenarion Tactical Badges to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also attain Friendly reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest.
notes: Badges don't drop from mobs. They come only as rewards from the assignment quests.

quests.name: Veteran's Battlegear
quests.text: Bring 7 Cenarion Combat Badges, 4 Cenarion Logistics Badges and 4 Cenarion Tactical Badges to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest.

quests.name: Champion's Battlegear
quests.text: Bring 15 Cenarion Combat Badges, 20 Cenarion Logistics Badges, 20 Cenarion Tactical Badges and 1 Mark of Cenarius to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest.

quests.name: Stalwart's Battlegear
quests.text: Bring 15 Cenarion Combat Badges, 20 Cenarion Logistics Badges, 17 Cenarion Tactical Badges and 1 Mark of Remulos to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also attain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest.

quests.name: Target: Hive'Zora Tunnelers
quests.text: Slay 30 Hive'Zora Tunnelers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing VII in order to complete this quest.
notes: Tunnelers are elite, so a group is recommended.

quests.name: Field Duty
quests.text: Report to Krug Skullsplit at the Orgrimmar Legion post in front of Hive'Regal. Prepare your Unsigned Field Duty Papers, obtain Signed Field Duty Papers and bring them to Windcaller Kaldon in Cenarion Hold.  Note: Healing or casting beneficial spells on a member of the Orgrimmar Legion will flag you for PvP.

quests.name: Azure Templar
quests.text: Summon and slay an Azure Templar and report back to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing I in order to complete this quest.
notes: The Azure Templar has no fixed spawn. You have to summon it at a Lesser Wind Stone while wearing the full Twilight set.
The templar is elite. Some players solo it, but bringing a group is safer.

quests.name: Hive'Regal Scout Report
quests.text: Contact Cenarion Scout Landion inside Hive'Regal and return the Hive'Regal Scout Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing VII in order to complete this quest.
notes: Tactical Task Briefing VII comes out of container item 20809 and must be carried when you turn in.

quests.name: Hive'Ashi Scout Report
quests.text: Contact Cenarion Scout Jalia inside Hive'Ashi and return the Hive'Ashi Scout Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing VIII in order to complete this quest.
notes: The briefing item must still be in your bags at turn-in. It comes out of container 21133.

quests.name: Twilight Marauders
quests.text: Slay Twilight Marauder Morna and 5 Twilight Marauders. Report to Windcaller Proudhorn when your task is finished. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing IX in order to complete this quest.

quests.name: Treasure of the Timeless One
notes: Tied to a world event (event 86), the Ahn'Qiraj gate opening.

quests.name: Target: Hive'Ashi Defenders
quests.text: Slay 30 Hive'Ashi Defenders and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing I in order to complete this quest.

quests.name: Target: Hive'Ashi Sandstalkers
quests.text: Slay 30 Hive'Ashi Sandstalkers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing II in order to complete this quest.
notes: The sandstalkers are elite, so bring a group.

quests.name: Target: Hive'Zora Waywatchers
quests.text: Slay 30 Hive'Zora Waywatchers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing VI in order to complete this quest.
notes: The waywatchers are elite, so you need a group.

quests.name: Target: Hive'Zora Reavers
quests.text: Slay 30 Hive'Zora Reavers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing IV in order to complete this quest.

quests.name: Target: Hive'Regal Ambushers
quests.text: Kill 30 Hive'Regal Ambushers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing VIII in order to complete this quest.
notes: Ambushers are elite, so bring a group.
The briefing item comes out of container 22649 and must still be in your bags when you turn in.

quests.name: Target: Hive'Regal Spitfires
quests.text: Kill 30 Hive'Regal Spitfires and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing IX in order to complete this quest.
notes: Spitfires are elite, so bring a group.

quests.name: Target: Hive'Regal Slavemakers
quests.text: Kill 30 Hive'Regal Slavemakers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing X in order to complete this quest.
notes: Slavemakers are elite, so bring a group.

quests.name: Target: Hive'Regal Burrowers
quests.text: Kill 30 Hive'Regal Burrowers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing XI in order to complete this quest.

quests.name: The Ironforge Brigade Needs Explosives!
quests.text: Bring 6 Oils of Immolation, 5 Goblin Rocket Fuel and 10 Dense Blasting Powder to Arcanist Nozzlespring near Hive'Zora in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing IV in order to complete this quest.

quests.name: Scrying Materials
quests.text: Bring 1 Large Brilliant Shard, 1 Large Radiant Shard and 1 Huge Emerald to Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing V in order to complete this quest.

quests.name: Armor Kits for the Field
quests.text: Bring 8 Rugged Armor Kits and 8 Heavy Armor Kits to Janela Stouthammer at the Ironforge Brigade Outpost near Hive'Zora in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing VII in order to complete this quest.
notes: The quest starts from Logistics Task Briefing VII, which comes out of a container item. That briefing must still be in your bags at turn-in.

quests.name: Arms for the Field
quests.text: Bring 2 Moonsteel Broadswords to Janela Stouthammer at the Ironforge Brigade Outpost outside of Hive'Zora. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing VI in order to complete this quest.
notes: Keep the Logistics Task Briefing VI in your bags, because the turn-in needs it. The briefing comes out of container item 21132.

quests.name: Uniform Supplies
quests.text: Bring 1 Mooncloth, 2 Bolts of Runecloth and 1 Ironweb Spider Silk to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing VIII in order to complete this quest.

quests.name: Extraordinary Materials
quests.text: Bring 2 Enchanted Thorium Bars and 2 Enchanted Leather to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing IX in order to complete this quest.
notes: The quest starts from a briefing item that comes out of container 20805. You must keep that briefing in your bags to turn the quest in.

quests.name: The Orgrimmar Legion Needs Mojo!
quests.text: Bring 6 Powerful Mojo, 6 Flasks of Big Mojo and 8 Oils of Immolation to Shadow Priestess Shai near Hive'Regal in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing IV in order to complete this quest.

quests.name: Arms for the Field
quests.text: Bring 3 Massive Iron Axes to Merok Longstride at the Orgrimmar Legion camp outside of Hive'Regal. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing VI in order to complete this quest.
notes: Each axe takes 14 Iron Bars, 2 Strong Flux, 2 Moss Agates, 4 Heavy Leather and 2 Heavy Grinding Stones.

quests.name: Armor Kits for the Field
quests.text: Bring 8 Rugged Armor Kits and 8 Heavy Armor Kits to Merok Longstride near Hive'Regal. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing VII in order to complete this quest.
notes: The briefing item that starts the quest comes out of container 21266 and must still be in your bags at turn-in.

quests.name: Cenarion Battlegear
quests.text: Talk to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

quests.name: Boots for the Guard
quests.text: Bring 3 Ornate Mithril Boots to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing II in order to complete this quest.
notes: The quest starts from the Logistics Task Briefing II item, which comes out of container item 21386. Keep the briefing in your bags until you turn in.

quests.name: Grinding Stones for the Guard
quests.text: Bring 10 Dense Grinding Stones, 10 Solid Grinding Stones and 10 Heavy Grinding Stones to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing III in order to complete this quest.

quests.name: Scrying Materials
quests.text: Bring 1 Large Brilliant Shard, 1 Large Radiant Shard and 1 Huge Emerald to Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing V in order to complete this quest.

quests.name: Uniform Supplies
quests.text: Bring 1 Mooncloth, 2 Bolts of Runecloth and 1 Ironweb Spider Silk to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing VIII in order to complete this quest.

quests.name: Extraordinary Materials
quests.text: Bring 2 Enchanted Thorium Bars and 2 Enchanted Leather to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing IX in order to complete this quest.
notes: The briefing item that starts the quest comes out of container item 21386 and must still be in your bags when you turn in.

quests.name: Bandages for the Field
quests.text: Bring 30 Heavy Runecloth Bandages, 30 Heavy Silk Bandages and 30 Heavy Mageweave Bandages to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing X in order to complete this quest.

quests.name: The Ultimate Deception
quests.text: Bring a Skin of Shadow, 3 Frayed Abomination Stitchings and 1 Twilight Cultist Robe to Aurel Goldleaf at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing XI in order to complete this quest.

quests.name: The Perfect Poison
quests.text: Dirk Thunderwood at Cenarion Hold wants you to bring him Venoxis's Venom Sac and Kurinnaxx's Venom Sac.
notes: Both sacs come from raid bosses, so you need a raid group for ZG and for AQ20.

21175.name: The Scepter of the Shifting Sands
